title: backlog.py check does not refuse a touch whose file a branch added and removed before it reached main
goal: backlog.py check's moved-or-deleted touch rule counts a path as gone only when origin/main's history has it, not a work branch's own add and remove; answers SP-uwkr7iyl, where ST-w3jhowin's branch added and removed _tools/test_census_route.py, check refused 12 items in four sprints at the landing gate, and the orchestrator repointed their touches by hand.
notes: Retrospective finding of SP-uwkr7iyl close, 2026-10-10. Its check passes before the work: planning replaces it with one that fails until the change lands.
